notes:
Original-source rule applied: no original statistics taken from replication sources. Replication registration title verified against supplied reference. The complete primary OSF registration reports both heat-versus-cold and heat-versus-neutral contrasts for Study 1; neither the neutral description nor supplied page locator uniquely identifies the assigned contrast. No contrast selected from input order. Primary author workbook retained separately in texts/bc5b203658b42d2fce58354d-primary-table.txt. It supplies contrast-specific n and d but no study-specific p. See this source and registration item30 for candidate contrasts. Replication locator pagination cannot be verified against the unpaginated registration. Candidate values (not assigned): author workbook Meta-Analyses row 5 columns n,d reports Experiment 1 heat versus neutral n=120, d=-0.02; row 23 reports Experiment 1 heat versus cold n=121, d=-0.12. Workbook n is the author-supplied contrast sample n; its exclusions are not documented in the workbook. These competing values cannot be mapped uniquely to this audit_id. Registration item30 independently identifies the same contrast-specific d values.
Source follow-up: Two distinct pairwise effects are printed on p.1046: hot versus cold d=.67 with F(1,69)=5.02, p<.03; hot versus neutral d=.63 with F(1,69)=4.23, p<.05. Neutral description and locator do not distinguish these tests; no effect/p selected. Omnibus F(2,69)=3.14, p<.05 is a third test. For rows whose locator says p.1047, the statistics are actually on p.1046.
